# Wapzen

> Wapzen is a free, no-code builder for WhatsApp AI chatbots and WhatsApp AI calling agents. Connect an existing personal WhatsApp or WhatsApp Business number by QR code (no WhatsApp Business API needed), then let AI agents auto-reply to messages, auto-answer inbound WhatsApp calls, and make outbound AI calls 24/7.

## What it does

- WhatsApp AI chatbot: an AI chat agent that auto-replies to incoming WhatsApp text messages, using an OpenAI GPT or Anthropic Claude model, your system prompt, knowledge bases, and API tools. Works on personal WhatsApp numbers, which have no built-in auto-reply, as well as WhatsApp Business numbers.
- WhatsApp AI voice agent: an AI calling agent that automatically answers inbound WhatsApp voice calls and places outbound calls in real time, with a configurable voice, language, transcriber, prompt, knowledge bases, and tools.
- AI outbound calling campaigns: add leads to a campaign, assign a voice agent, and each lead is called on WhatsApp; review campaign activity and analytics.
- Knowledge bases: train agents on text, PDF, and Word documents; agents search them during chats and calls.
- API request tools: let agents take actions in your own systems, such as checking an order or booking an appointment.
- Conversation review: WhatsApp chat history, call history, and call transcripts in one dashboard.

## Pricing

- Wapzen is currently free to use, with every feature included: $0 per month, no credit card.
- AI models (OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude), speech, and voices are included; no customer API keys are needed.
- No WhatsApp Business API, so no Meta per-message fees. Calls run over WhatsApp, with no per-minute charges.
- AI calls are WhatsApp voice calls only; Wapzen does not dial regular phone numbers.
- Details: [Pricing](/pricing)

## Use cases

- AI customer service on WhatsApp
- WhatsApp AI receptionist for incoming calls
- Appointment booking over chat or voice
- AI sales agent for replying to and qualifying leads
- Outbound follow-up and reminder calls
- AI auto-reply on a personal or business WhatsApp number

## Industries

- Real estate: answer property enquiries, call new leads back, qualify buyers and renters.
- Clinics and dental practices: share hours, services, and prices; answer patient calls; take appointment requests.
- E-commerce stores: answer product, delivery, and return questions; check order status through a connected API tool.
- Restaurants: menu, opening hours, and reservation questions by chat or call.
- Education: course, fee, and admission questions; call back prospective students and parents.
- Travel and local services: package, pricing, and availability questions in the customer's language.

## Setup

1. Connect a WhatsApp number from the dashboard by scanning a QR code.
2. Create a chat agent (WhatsApp AI chatbot) or voice agent (WhatsApp AI calling agent) and set its prompt and model options.
3. Attach relevant knowledge bases and tools.
4. Review conversations, calls, and outbound campaigns in the dashboard.
